en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate dining room prepared for a banquet. Two very long tables covered with white tablecloths run along both sides of a carpeted central aisle, each lined with wooden chairs with cane backs. Potted palms and flowering plants decorate the tables and corners of the room. The space features elaborate wooden sideboards and door frames, high ceilings with decorative plasterwork, a large central chandelier with floral glass shades, and tall curtained windows letting in bright light.
